reminders: 1. Contract-First: Define Rust IPC structs & TypeScript interfaces before writing business logic.
2. TDD: Write failing tests before production code (Node native runner for frontend, cargo test for Rust).
3. Micro-Validation: Run `python .agents/scripts/verify_shift_left.py --changed` after every file edit.
4. PrimeVue Foundation: No raw HTML <button>/<input>/<select>; use PrimeVue with v-tooltip.
5. Boundary: No native desktop runtime imports in components/composables (route via @/services/*).

banned_imports.description: Direct native desktop runtime import in UI/composables
banned_imports.suggestion: Route OS/runtime interactions through centralized services in `@/services/*` instead.

banned_patterns.description: Rust `.unwrap()` call in production engine code
banned_patterns.suggestion: Handle errors explicitly with `?` or `match` / `if let` returning Result<T, E>.

banned_patterns.description: Rust `.expect(...)` call in production engine code
banned_patterns.suggestion: Handle recoverable errors explicitly or log diagnostic failure via Result<T, E>.

banned_patterns.description: Rust `panic!(...)` macro in production engine code
banned_patterns.suggestion: Return structured errors across IPC boundary instead of crashing backend engine.
Use design tokens (var(--accent), var(--border), var(--bg-card), etc.) from base.css.

banned_attributes.suggestion: Use PrimeVue `v-tooltip="'...'"` directive instead of native title attribute.
